title: Cacio e Pepe - Alex
description: A classic Roman pasta dish with just three ingredients: pasta, pecorino cheese, and black pepper. The technique creates a silky, creamy sauce through emulsification using pasta water and starch.
notes: No butter, no cream, no eggs, no oil. The creaminess comes from emulsifying the cheese with starchy pasta water. Use freshly ground black pepper as a main flavor component, not just seasoning. If you master this technique, you can add guanciale to make pasta alla gricia, or add tomatoes to make bucatini all'amatriciana.

steps.text: Bring a pot of salted water to a boil and cook {i1} according to package directions until al dente. Reserve pasta cooking water before draining.
While pasta cooks, toast {i3} in a large pan over medium heat until fragrant.
Add a ladleful of starchy pasta cooking water to the pan with the pepper to create the base of the sauce.
Add the cooked pasta to the pan and toss to coat. Remove from heat.

Add {i2} gradually while tossing vigorously, adding small amounts of pasta water as needed to create a silky, creamy emulsion that coats the pasta. The starch in the pasta water helps emulsify the cheese and water into a smooth sauce.
Serve immediately while the sauce is creamy and smooth.
